build_make_options: build a dict of observable configuration options from ObservationSettings and ObservableNames using make_options
create_ObservableSpec: create an ObservableSpec namedtuple to configure a generic observable with enabled, update_interval, and buffer_size
create_CameraObservableSpec: create a CameraObservableSpec namedtuple to configure a camera observable with height, width, and enabled fields
create_ObservationSettings: create an ObservationSettings namedtuple to group ObservableSpecs by proprio, ftt, prop_pose, board_state, and camera categories
create_ObservableNames: create an ObservableNames namedtuple to group observable names by category with default empty tuples
